# MetroEHS Pediatric Therapy

> MetroEHS is a Michigan-based pediatric therapy provider specializing in ABA therapy, speech, occupational, physical, feeding, and mental health services across multiple clinic locations.

MetroEHS operates numerous therapy centers throughout Michigan (Detroit metro area, East Lansing, and surrounding regions) and offers both in-person and teletherapy services. The organization serves children with autism spectrum disorders, developmental delays, feeding disorders, and other pediatric therapy needs, with resources for parents and staffing solutions for schools.

## Key Topics

- ABA Therapy
- Speech Therapy
- Occupational Therapy
- Physical Therapy
- Feeding Therapy
- Mental Health Services

## Core Therapy Services

- [ABA Therapy - Autism Therapy in Michigan](https://www.metroehs.com/aba-therapy): Results-driven ABA therapy services for children with autism
- [Speech Therapy - MetroEHS Pediatric Therapy](https://www.metroehs.com/pediatric-speech-therapy): Speech language pathology services for communication disorders
- [Occupational Therapy - MetroEHS Pediatric Therapy](https://www.metroehs.com/pediatric-occupational-therapy): OT services for sensory, motor skills and daily living activities
- [Physical Therapy - MetroEHS Pediatric Therapy](https://www.metroehs.com/pediatric-physical-therapy): Physical therapy for developmental milestones and neurological conditions
- [Pediatric Feeding Therapy | G-Tube & Intensive Feeding Therapy](https://www.metroehs.com/feeding-swallowing-therapy): Specialized feeding therapy for disorders and G-tube management
- [Mental Health Services - MetroEHS Pediatric Therapy](https://www.metroehs.com/mental-health-services): Individual and group mental health therapy for children and families

## Delivery & Support Services

- [Teletherapy - MetroEHS Pediatric Therapy](https://www.metroehs.com/teletherapy): Remote therapy services via virtual platforms for all specialties
- [Special Education Staffing - MetroEHS Pediatric Therapy](https://www.metroehs.com/special-education-staffing): School staffing solutions for IEP support and teletherapy services
- [Lactation Consulting Services - Michigan](https://www.metroehs.com/lactation-services): Expert lactation guidance and breastfeeding support services

## Therapy Centers - Detroit Metro

- [Bloomfield Hills Pediatric Therapy Center - ABA, OT, PT, & Feeding](https://www.metroehs.com/locations/bloomfield-hills-therapy-center): Bloomfield Hills therapy center with ABA, speech, OT, PT & feeding
- [Detroit Pediatric Therapy - ABA, OT, PT, Feeding, & Speech](https://www.metroehs.com/locations/detroit-therapy-center): Detroit location with comprehensive ABA, speech, OT, PT services
- [Dearborn Therapy Center - ABA Therapy in Dearborn, MI](https://www.metroehs.com/locations/dearborn-therapy-center): Dearborn therapy center with ABA, speech, OT, PT and feeding therapy
- [Dearborn Heights Pediatric Clinic - ABA Therapy Dearborn Heights](https://www.metroehs.com/locations/dearborn-heights-therapy-center): Dearborn Heights clinic offering ABA, speech, OT, PT and feeding
- [Brownstown Therapy Center - MetroEHS Pediatric Therapy](https://www.metroehs.com/locations/brownstown-therapy-center): Brownstown location offering comprehensive pediatric therapy services

## Therapy Centers - Greater Michigan

- [Clarkston Therapy Center - MetroEHS Pediatric Therapy](https://www.metroehs.com/locations/clarkston-therapy-center): Clarkston therapy center with ABA, speech, OT, PT and more
- [Davison Therapy Center - MetroEHS Pediatric Therapy](https://www.metroehs.com/locations/davison-therapy-center): Davison location providing full range of pediatric therapy services
- [East Lansing Pediatric Therapy Center - ABA, OT, PT, & Feeding](https://www.metroehs.com/locations/east-lansing-therapy-center): East Lansing therapy center offering ABA, OT, PT and feeding therapy
